title: Phase-Aware CNN for Real-Time 5G/6G Channel Estimation with Hardware-in-the-loop Validation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14676v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In 5G/6G wireless systems, accurate and timely channel estimation is critical to ensure reliable communication under complex, fast-changing radio conditions. This work focuses on pilot-based channel estimation using deep learning to reconstruct both magnitude and phase across the full subcarrier grid, with particular emphasis on evaluation using emulated data collected from an end-to-end O-RAN testbed. The testbed includes hardware in the loop and controlled channel emulation to better reflect deployment conditions beyond pure software simulation. It addresses major limitations in classical estimators such as LS and MMSE, as well as deep learning-based approaches that struggle with phase prediction due to discontinuities at $\pm \pi$, poor generalization to different UE and antenna configurations, and computational inefficiency for real-time deployment. translated_title: 面向实时5G/6G信道估计的相位感知CNN及硬件在环验证
translated_abstract: 在5G/6G无线系统中，准确且及时的信道估计对于在复杂、快速变化的无线电条件下确保可靠通信至关重要。本研究聚焦于基于导频的信道估计，利用深度学习重建整个子载波网格上的幅度和相位，特别强调使用从端到端O-RAN测试平台收集的仿真数据进行评估。该测试平台包含硬件在环和受控信道仿真，以更好地反映超越纯软件模拟的部署条件。它解决了经典估计器（如LS和MMSE）的主要局限性，以及基于深度学习的方法在相位预测中面临的挑战，这些挑战包括在$\pm \pi$处的不连续性、对不同用户设备和天线配置的泛化能力差，以及实时部署的计算效率低下。所提出的系统结合了使用正弦和余弦表示的相位感知输入编码。
tldr: 本文提出了一种相位感知的CNN方法，通过正弦/余弦编码解决相位不连续性问题，并在含硬件在环的O-RAN测试平台上验证了其在高实时性和泛化性方面的优势。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a phase-aware CNN that addresses phase discontinuity via sine/cosine encoding, validated on an O-RAN testbed with hardware-in-the-loop for improved real-time performance and generalization.
